entities.name: Mightstone and Weakstone
entities.description: The two halves of a Thran powerstone; the Mightstone empowers artifacts and the Weakstone deactivates them. They played a part in the founding of Phyrexia and the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: A planeswalker who cracked a large powerstone in half to establish a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A Thran who secretly placed the two halves inside Glacian and whose evil nature Rebbec discovered.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: A Thran artificer whose essence the stones absorbed.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Glacian's wife, who recombined the stones to close the portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer who took the Mightstone, became a planeswalker whose eyes the stones merged with, and used the Golgothian Sylex against his brother.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother who took the Weakstone and became Qadir and leader of the Fallaji.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: The master of Urza and Mishra, accidentally killed when she tried to calm them.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Yotia's crown princess whom Urza married and who schemed to give the Mightstone to Mishra.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: A woman who freed Mishra from labor and helped him retrieve the Weakstone.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: The leader of the Fallaji killed by Ashnod; Mishra later ascended as Qadir.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Mishra's apprentice who killed the Qadir.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian who tried to steal the Weakstone and murder Mishra, then decided to corrupt Mishra.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: A desert people who enslaved Mishra and later followed him.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: An angel who replaced Serra, plucked the stones from Urza's eyes, and died when she put them together.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: The creator of Serra's Realm who fled after the Phyrexian attack.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: The man who removed the stones from Urza's eyes and combined them in Karn's chest, dying in the process.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A being who became a planeswalker when the combined stones merged with him.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The weapon Urza used to obliterate Mishra's army and level Argoth.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The long war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane connected to Dominaria through the portal Dyfed created.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: A wizard said to use a forgery of the Mightstone, captured by Gull and Greensleeves's army.

events.summary: Dyfed cracks a powerstone in half to open a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia.
events.quote: The planeswalker Dyfed cracked a large powerstone in half to establish a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia

events.summary: Rebbec recombines the stones to close the portal and seals Yawgmoth in Phyrexia.
events.quote: his wife Rebbec discovered Yawgmoth's evil nature and recombined the two halves to close the portal Dyfed had created, sealing him in Phyrexia.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra uncover the stones in the Hall of Tagsin, each taking one, which reactivates the gate to Phyrexia.
events.quote: Urza took the Mightstone and Mishra the Weakstone, unwittingly reactivating the gate to Phyrexia.

events.summary: The jealous brothers use the stones against each other and accidentally kill Tocasia, then separate.
events.quote: accidentally killing Tocasia when she tried to calm them

events.summary: Mishra is enslaved by the Fallaji, freed by Hajar, learns he can control a dragon engine, and begins the Brothers' War.
events.quote: Mishra found that he could control it .

events.summary: The Weakstone protects Mishra from Gix, who decides to corrupt Mishra instead.
events.quote: Gix then decided to corrupt Mishra instead.

events.summary: Urza finds Kayla with Mishra, negotiations collapse and war is declared; Ashnod kills the Qadir and Mishra ascends as Qadir.
events.quote: Mishra would then ascend as Qadir and leader of the Fallaji.

events.summary: Urza uses the Golgothian Sylex to obliterate Mishra and his army, levels Argoth, and becomes a planeswalker as the stones merge into his eyes.
events.quote: Urza used the Golgothian Sylex to obliterate his brother and his army.

events.summary: Radiant plucks the stones from Urza's eyes in Serra's Sanctum and dies when she puts them together, restoring Urza.
events.quote: Radiant then foolishly put the two stones together, triggering an explosion that killed the angel and restored Urza.

events.summary: Gerrard combines the stones inside Karn's chest, driving Yawgmoth from Dominaria, killing Gerrard and making Karn a planeswalker.
events.quote: triggering a burst of energy that drove Yawgmoth from Dominaria while killing Gerrard and causing Karn to become a planeswalker.
